english: If I had known, I would have come.

czech: Kdybych tě byl viděl, pozdravil bych tě.
english: If I had seen you, I would have greeted you.

czech: Kdybych byl měl čas, pomohl bych ti.
english: If I had had time, I would have helped you.
If it hadn’t rained, we would have gone out.

czech: Kdybych byl studoval víc, udělal bych zkoušku.
english: If I had studied more, I would have passed the exam.

czech: Kdybych byl vyhrál v loterii, koupil bych si dům.
english: If I had won the lottery, I would have bought a house.

czech: Kdybych byl slyšel ten zvuk, zastavil bych se.
english: If I had heard the sound, I would have stopped.

czech: Kdybych byl jedl snídani, nebyl bych hladový.
english: If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn’t have been hungry.
